verdict.rationale: OCI documents a first-party Terraform provider and Resource Manager service with state import/migration (oracle-cloud-docs-6, oracle-cloud-docs-7), giving a template-based IaC surface, but there is no evidence of a typed CDK-style programming framework (e.g., an OCI CDK) or documented rollback semantics beyond state-file import guidance. missing for 10: typed CDK-style SDK for IaC, explicit rollback/drift-recovery documentation, independent corroboration of state management reliability.
